verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an open-source edition is a fair question for a web-scraping product, but the evidence shows ScrapingBee only as a hosted API that requires an API key and calls app.scrapingbee.com. The GitHub-hosted CLI is a client for that hosted service, not a self-hostable scraper. Community suggestions to run local tools like Dusk instead are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service
